item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and its nearby context, then flag only concrete issues.

The module provides small order helpers: totals line items, applies two discount codes, computes an “average item price,” and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:

- [orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w/test/orders.js:5) loops with `i <= items.length`, so the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (`undefined`) and throws when reading `.price`. Use `i < items.length`.
- [orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w/test/orders.js:18) calculates total *line value* (`price × qty`) but divides by the number of distinct item records. If “average item price” means per unit, it should divide by total quantity; otherwise the name is misleading.
- [orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w/test/orders.js:20) returns `NaN` for an empty item list (`0 / 0`), likely requiring explicit handling.
